purpose: Teach: かもめ/持ち歩く/炊飯/日替わり/湿っ/ミニチュア/玉子/アテ

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、海沿いの、本気で、絶対、お店で、絶対、かもめ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、見てきたわよ
lines.en: I went by your shop the other day and I actually saw the seagulls outside.
lines.style: Warm opening, conversational pace. Gentle enthusiasm lighting up on 'seagulls.' Relaxed, like sharing something she noticed and wanted to mention.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: うん。葵、本気で、絶対、業務用の、絶対、ノート、絶対、持ち歩く、絶対、よ、メイちゃん
lines.en: Yeah, I actually carry a notebook around for work stuff — you know how it is.
lines.style: Straightforward, matter-of-fact. Light on 'actually,' no pretense. Modest, like it's just something she does. Easy rhythm.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵のお店の、本気で、絶対、炊飯、絶対、設備、絶対、業務用で、絶対、立派よね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: Your rice cooker setup is really impressive, you know? The commercial-grade equipment — it shows you actually care about what you're doing.
lines.style: Genuine admiration, unhurried. Soft landing on 'impressive.' Noticing something real, not flattering. Warm acknowledgment underneath.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、日替わり、絶対、ランチ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、毎日、絶対、楽しみよ
lines.en: I look forward to your daily lunch special every single day, honestly.
lines.style: Light brightness, emphasis lands on 'every single day.' A little vulnerable underneath — she means it. Not performative, just honest.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、お店、絶対、湿った、絶対、空気、絶対、対策、絶対、頑張ってるよね、メイちゃん、本気で、絶対、感心
lines.en: The way you've really worked to keep the air in your shop fresh and dry — I notice that. It shows.
lines.style: Quieter, more reflective tone. Slow and observant, like she's naming something Aoi might not realise she's doing. Tender recognition.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、ミニチュア、絶対、ハウス、絶対、お店に、絶対、飾ってるよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I saw the miniature house you put on display in the shop — it's charming.
lines.style: Animated warmth. Light, appreciative. Smile in the voice. Genuinely delighted by a small detail that matters.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 葵の、本気で、絶対、玉子、絶対、サンドイッチ、絶対、メイちゃん、絶対、大好きよ
lines.en: Your egg sandwiches are really something special — I love them.
lines.style: Direct sincerity, soft start. Gentle emphasis on 'really.' No hedging, just stating something true. Tender and sure.

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 葵、本気で、絶対、夜の、絶対、お酒の、絶対、アテ、絶対、メニュー、絶対、増やしたよ、メイちゃん
lines.en: I'm glad you're expanding the evening menu with snacks for drinks — it's a nice direction for the place.
lines.style: Pleased, measured affection. Thoughtful pace. Acknowledging something Aoi's building, rooting for her quietly without needing to say so directly.
